items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And Al went to the rooming house... we were sitting down eating fried chicken... So finally Max said, 'You want to go?' 'Yeah, we'll go.' So after the job was through we went to this fraternity house

ctx.x: -- and Al went to the rooming house. And when they came -- I called them, and when they came to pick us up, we were sitting down eating fried chicken, and they said, 'Well, why didn't you bring us here to this place?' And we were having a ball, you know.

So we finally went on to this college to play this -- play this concert or dance. I think It was a dance. And there was a lot of Northern kids at this college from New York and everything. So the thing went over good. So they invited us to the frat house after we got through.
